invariants.name: ime_does_not_layout_full_tree
invariants.note: IME preedit/commit must not default to a full-tree layout. Live dump layouts 0 on a focused TextInput. ime_script_count is attendance, not this hotspot. Missing layout_nodes stays not-evaluable.

notes: Mapped onto AppContext set_ime_preedit / commit_ime on a focused TextInput in an isolated AppContext. Measures Runtime preedit + commit_ime only. Does not measure the OS IME candidate window, composition UI, or host IME popup. commit_ime is the Runtime candidate-commit path. Correctness asserts preedit then committed text per script.
